clean: This winter we're trying something new at the shop. Every Thursday evening from November through February, we'll be running a free basic maintenance class, limited to eight people a night because that's how many work stands we have. You don't need any experience, and you don't need to have bought your bike from us, honestly we'd love to see some of the bikes that have been sitting in people's sheds since the pandemic. Bring your own bike if you can, and if you can't, Marjorie has a couple of loaners. Sign up at the counter or on our website at spokeandsprocket.co.uk/classes.
